title: Quick Ache Separation Design and Approval
learningGoal: Design and obtain approval for a safe evidence-based separation without receiving a hidden recipe.

actions.label: Draft the separation flowchart

parameters.prompt: For every proposed physical stage, name the material, sequence, amount, time, precision, concentration, chemical rationale, retained fraction, and evidence to collect.
parameters.note: Stage-by-stage separation flowchart recorded, pairing each physical step with its chemical rationale, amounts, times, and precision.

interaction.accessibleLabel: Record evidence for Draft the separation flowchart.

stateChanges: Draft the separation flowchart evidence is recorded.

invalidCases.when: current node expects a different action
invalidCases.message: That action is out of sequence for the approved investigation.
invalidCases.recovery: Return to the highlighted step and preserve the fraction or evidence already collected.

invalidCases.when: execution is attempted before instructor approval
invalidCases.message: The separation plan has not been approved.
invalidCases.recovery: Submit the property evidence, chemical rationale, quantities, endpoints, and disposal plan for instructor approval.

invalidCases.when: a layer or recovered fraction lacks identity and provenance
invalidCases.message: The fraction cannot be interpreted safely without a label.
invalidCases.recovery: Label the vessel with source stage, observed layer, retained material, and uncertainty before continuing.

feedback.invalid: Record the required evidence and use the teacher-approved configuration before continuing.

actions.label: Audit safety and recovery branches

parameters.prompt: Address ethyl acetate ignition control, acid/base exposure, separatory-funnel venting away from people, emulsion recovery, wrong-layer recovery, heating limits, and teacher-designated waste.
parameters.note: Safety audit recorded for the proposed plan: goggles, acid and base burn hazards, ethyl acetate ignition sources, heating limits, and waste destinations.

actions.label: Record instructor approval

parameters.prompt: The instructor records approval only after the plan can safely isolate every required component. Approval does not reveal a fixed solvent sequence, identity outcome, or recovery target.
parameters.note: Instructor approval recorded for the student-authored separation plan.
